core_claims.name: substPres / substitution
core_claims.scope: For arbitrary source and destination scopes, environments, terms, values, and substitutions, pointwise semantic evidence for the substituted variables transports every Denote derivation through simultaneous substitution. The single-variable corollary has no value or normalization side condition.

core_claims.name: renameReflect / renameShiftReflect
core_claims.scope: Renaming reflects every semantic observation when the target environment composed with the renaming is pointwise below the source environment. No injectivity or function extensionality hypothesis is needed.

core_claims.name: substReflect / substitutionReflect
core_claims.scope: From any finite semantic derivation of a simultaneously substituted arbitrary term, construct a finite-information source environment, evidence that every substitution image supplies its demanded value, and a derivation for the original term. Application and join cases construct joined environments; the single-substitution corollary constructs the argument approximation rather than assuming it.

core_claims.name: preserve / reflect
core_claims.scope: Every full untyped beta Step preserves and reflects every Denote judgment in every environment, including AppLeft, AppRight, and UnderLam. No typing, closedness, evaluation strategy, or termination premise is added.

core_claims.name: stepSoundness / soundness
core_claims.scope: For arbitrary scoped terms and arbitrary endpoints, Step or finite Steps implies pointwise SemEq in every environment at every information value. Both directions are proved, not supplied as assumptions.

exercises.scope: Semantic equivalence of every open beta redex and its capture-avoiding reduct.
Replacing an unused arbitrary argument, including divergent arguments, preserves the denotation of the identity result.
Semantic equality for a beta contraction underneath an outer lambda, at arbitrary outer scope.

deviations: Intrinsically scoped Nat/Fin syntax replaces Agda's context syntax; environment equality and comparison are pointwise and do not use function extensionality.
substReflect structurally analyzes the source term and semantic derivation rather than threading a separate equality identifying the substituted term.

The name soundness covers arbitrary endpoints by iterating upstream reduce-equal; upstream reserves that name for its lambda-endpoint special case. This is not advertised as a result unavailable upstream.
